author: RugkeyPro
description: macOS 专用本地文件链接右键菜单增强：支持在 Finder 中显示、使用默认应用打开、选择系统关联应用（打开方式）、应用内预览及复制完整或相对路径。仅支持 macOS，目前内置原生助手仅编译了 Apple Silicon (arm64) 版本。

en.name: Mac File Open Enhancer (macOS Apple Silicon)
en.description: macOS context-menu enhancer for local file links in chat: Reveal in Finder, Open with Default App, Open With any macOS-associated application, preview in PI-Desktop, and copy full or relative paths. macOS only; the bundled native helper is currently compiled for Apple Silicon (arm64) only.
en.safetyNotes: macOS only; the bundled native helper (native-open) is currently compiled for Apple Silicon (arm64) only. File actions run strictly on explicit user click and are confined to regular files inside the active local project or session scratch directory (blocking sensitive directories and executable or script extensions). Uses macOS NSWorkspace APIs via execFile without shell command interpolation, never alters system default app associations, and makes no network requests. The renderer extension runs in the host window to attach the context menu.

zh-CN.name: Mac 文件打开增强（macOS Apple Silicon）
zh-CN.description: macOS 专用本地文件链接右键菜单增强：支持在 Finder 中显示、使用默认应用打开、选择系统关联应用（打开方式）、应用内预览及复制完整或相对路径。仅支持 macOS，目前内置原生助手仅编译了 Apple Silicon (arm64) 版本。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 仅支持 macOS，且当前内置原生助手（native-open）仅编译了 Apple Silicon (arm64) 版本。所有文件操作均仅由用户右键点击触发，严格限制在当前本地项目目录或当前会话附件目录内的普通文件（拒绝敏感目录与可执行脚本后缀）。通过 macOS NSWorkspace 原生接口枚举关联应用并打开文件，不拼接或执行 shell 命令字符串，不修改系统默认应用，不联网。渲染扩展在应用窗口内运行以挂载右键菜单。
